The analysis met statistical adequacy standards (Bartlett's test and KMO measure) and revealed a single factor explaining 56.9% of total item variance, with all item-factor loadings being very good (≥.63). The text references Table 1 for detailed component matrix results but does not provide demographic or sample characteristics.
